description: This file defines the PDFWrapper class within the SuiteCRM PDF namespace, responsible for managing PDF engine classes such as TCPDFEngine and LegacyMPDFEngine. It includes engine registration, retrieval, and dynamic loading mechanisms, along with configuration handling.

classes.name: PDFWrapper
classes.description: A class providing static methods for managing and instantiating PDF engine classes within the SuiteCRM framework, including engine registration, configuration, and dynamic loading.

methods.name: addEngine
methods.description: Registers a new PDF engine with its name, file path, and fully qualified class name.

methods.name: getPDFEngine
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of the default or configured PDF engine, loading external configurations if available.

methods.name: getEngines
methods.description: Returns an array of available PDF engine class names, considering custom extensions and environment constraints.

methods.name: getDefaultEngine
methods.description: Returns the default PDF engine name from configuration, or the first registered engine if unspecified.

methods.name: fetchEngine
methods.description: Loads and returns an instance of the specified PDF engine class, performing subclass checks and dynamic require.

methods.name: getPDFConfig
methods.description: Fetches PDF-related configuration options from the global $sugar_config array.

methods.name: getController
methods.description: Retrieves the configured controller name for PDF handling.
